name: Ensembl REST API
tagline: Genome annotation and comparative genomics REST API from EMBL-EBI
description: Ensembl's public REST API provides programmatic access to genome annotation, gene models, sequence, variation, homology, and comparative genomics data across vertebrate and model organism assemblies. It is the standard HTTP interface for querying Ensembl databases without bulk FTP downloads.

auth.details: No API key or OAuth required for the public REST service; requests are unauthenticated over HTTPS. Optional User-Agent identification is recommended by EMBL-EBI for fair-use tracking.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Fully free public service; no paid plans. Subject to published rate limits and fair-use policy.

rate_limits: 15 requests/second per IP (global rate limit); 5500 requests/hour recommended maximum; bulk/download use discouraged via REST—use FTP or Perl/Python APIs for large jobs.
use_cases: look up a human gene by symbol and get Ensembl ID and genomic coordinates
fetch genomic sequence for a region or transcript
get VEP-style variant consequences for a SNP or indel
retrieve orthologs/homologs for a gene across species
list transcripts and exons for a gene
